title: When the Compass Wakes
author: Odile Sterling
blurb: Wren Fairweather, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
